feeds.title: Have Baby Will Travel

Don't be afraid to travel with baby! Subscribe us to keep up with Tips, information, advice, and support for flying, driving, and all travel with babies, toddlers, and young children.

feeds.title: Baby Can Travel Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to inspire young families to travel with their children. We will lead by example and share the knowledge we gain with our new friends. Our series of travel guides and blog posts will offer pertinent travel information on top travel destinations which will enable young families to more effectively plan their trips and to maximize their enjoyment of their trips.

feeds.title: Family Adventures in the Canadian Rockies
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Tanya Koob, a mom, and wife to an amazing husband living in Calgary, Alberta, Canada at the doorstep of the fabulous Rocky Mountains. This blog seeks to chronicle the joys and challenges of taking kids hiking, camping, backpacking, skiing, biking, paddling, and all-out exploring in the Canadian Rockies. Follow the blog to explore more.
